name: Price Information 10
definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

CurrentPrice.name: Current Price
CurrentPrice.definition: Current value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of price and information about the price.

PreviousPrice.name: Previous Price
PreviousPrice.definition: Previous value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

AmountOfChange.name: Amount Of Change
AmountOfChange.definition: Difference or change between the previous price value and the current price value.
